pairs.ref: less pressure is needed when playing your clarinet
last week our fridge broke which forced us to eat lots of ice cream
it also passes through the san francisco peaks the highest mountains in arizona
mr tereso kangleon was reelected for another term
however most sloanes were not aristocrats as lady diana was
none of the class was named
youre an ancient soul i always say
this produces a conventional video signal that can be viewed on a normal television

quant.weights: int8 symmetric, per-tensor weight_exp (int64), xavier init quantized scale-preserving (NITI TiFloatToInt8 semantics)
quant.activations: int8 + tracked exponent; act_calc rescales int32 accum to 7-bit
quant.features: int8 per-sample max-abs quantization of normalized log-mel
quant.grads: psto_shift quantization to 7 bits (BITWIDTH), int32 accumulation
quant.updates: int16 subtract in weight_update (NITI-style integer SGD)
quant.rail_rescale: value-preserving weight re-quantization when at-rail fraction >= threshold (codes>>1, weight_exp+1)
quant.ctc_error: float CTCLoss grad wrt int8 logits, quantized to int8 (documented compromise)
